steps.name: ASR parakeet model loads from a path that exists in packaged DMG resources
steps.evidence_path_or_command_output: ls -la /Applications/Anticipy.app/Contents/Resources/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3/ shows the bundled model: config.json (244 KB), model.safetensors (2.5 GB), tokenizer.model, tokenizer.vocab, vocab.txt. THIS IS V3. engine/app/audiostack/audio.py:123 hardcodes _ASR_MODEL = 'mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2' (V2, NOT V3). _get_asr() at line 179-186 calls from_pretrained(_ASR_MODEL) which downloads from HuggingFace Hub at runtime instead of loading the bundled v3 weights. HF_HOME is redirected to $ANTICIPY_DATA_DIR/models/hf at line 39, so the v3 weights at /Applications/Anticipy.app/Contents/Resources/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3/ are NEVER touched. engine/app/proactive/asr.py:51 uses the correct v3 string DEFAULT_MODEL = 'mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3'. Two bugs: (a) audiostack/audio.py uses v2 not v3, version mismatch with the bundled weights; (b) neither v2 nor v3 path resolves to the bundled DMG resources, so first ASR call requires a 2.5 GB network download to ~/.anticipy/system_v1/models/hf, undercutting the 'works offline first launch' claim. On a fresh stranger Mac the user will wait 5+ minutes for ASR weights to download before the first mic capture transcribes.
steps.fix_recommendation: (1) Bump audiostack/audio.py:123 _ASR_MODEL to 'mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3' to match the bundled weights. (2) Add a bundle-resource path check before falling back to HF Hub: if sys._MEIPASS or /Applications/Anticipy.app/Contents/Resources/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 exists, point HF_HOME at it or call from_pretrained with the local path. (3) Verify parakeet_mlx.from_pretrained supports a filesystem path argument (typical HF loaders do). (4) Add a smoke test that runs a 1-second silent wav through ASR with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 to prove the bundled weights are loaded without network.

engine/app/product/server.py:8207 falls back to 'omarkebrahim@gmail.com' as the default user email if ANTICIPY_USER_EMAIL env var is unset. This is the only hardcoded Omar-specific value in shipped code. The env var override path works, but the default means every stranger user defaults to mailing Omar.
additional_findings.fix_recommendation: Replace the hardcoded fallback with the Supabase user email retrieved from the session token exchanged in step 7. Until the user has signed in, the value should be empty and the receipt-email code path should no-op rather than email Omar.

additional_findings.finding: install.sh line 222 unconditionally runs 'rm -rf /Applications/Anticipy.app' on every install. This means re-running the script destroys any user state held inside the .app bundle (none today, but it removes the bundled parakeet weights and requires re-download of the 2.5 GB DMG every time). Also means a corrupted download can wipe a working install before validating the new image is bootable.
additional_findings.fix_recommendation: Move the destination to a side-by-side stage (e.g. /Applications/Anticipy.app.new), validate it boots, then atomic-rename. Skip the destroy if the new DMG version matches the existing CFBundleShortVersionString.

additional_findings.finding: install.sh requires python3>=3.10 from the system (line 122-126). macOS Tahoe ships with python3 3.9 by default. A stranger user on a stock Mac will hit 'Anticipy: Python 3.10+ is required for the Chrome native bridge (found 3.9).' and the install aborts before the DMG is even downloaded.
additional_findings.fix_recommendation: Either bundle a Python 3.12 venv inside the DMG and skip the system-python check entirely, or check for python3.11/python3.12 first and degrade gracefully. The native bridge daemon does not need to share python with the user; PyInstaller-freeze it like the engine.

additional_findings.finding: Probe engine startup emits 'JWT_SECRET not set using insecure development default. Set this in .env' and 'PROFILE_ENCRYPTION_KEY not set using derived development key.' These appear in stderr on every cold launch with no env file. For a stranger install with no ~/.anticipy/.env they are the user's permanent state.
additional_findings.fix_recommendation: Generate per-install JWT_SECRET and PROFILE_ENCRYPTION_KEY at first launch and write them to ~/.anticipy/.env atomically. Today the dev defaults mean every stranger install shares the same secret key, which is a security regression if cookies or browser_profiles ever round-trip across hosts.
